steps.title: Epidermal Clearing
steps.description: The skin surface is meticulously cleansed and prepared using medical-grade formulations to ensure zero barrier interference.

steps.title: Pathway Micro-Channels
steps.description: Microscopic pathways are gently opened in the dermis, setting up the structural guide channels for deep cell permeability.

steps.title: Exosome Influx
steps.description: Pure, clinical-grade signaling exosomes are introduced, delivering growth factors and signaling lipids directly to the deep dermal matrix.

steps.title: Cellular Sealing
steps.description: A soothing bio-active sealant is applied to calm the tissue, lock in the exosomes, and initiate immediate cellular repair.

steps.title: BAP Mapping
steps.description: Meticulous marking of the 5 key Bio Aesthetic Points (BAP) on each side of the face to optimize dermal diffusion.

steps.title: Micro-Targeted Delivery
steps.description: Ultra-pure hyaluronic acid is precisely injected at calibrated depths into each designated BAP site with minimal discomfort.

steps.title: Dynamic Hydration Diffusion
steps.description: The dual-weight hyaluronic acid complex begins to slowly diffuse evenly across the surrounding skin tissues.

steps.title: Bio-Remodeling Cycle
steps.description: Continuous stimulation of 4 distinct collagen and elastin types, progressively lifting and remodeling sagging skin tissue.

steps.title: Subdermal Mapping
steps.description: Calibrating needle penetration depths (ranging from 1mm to 4mm) to target the specific thickness of skin and localized fat.

steps.title: Micro-Needle Penetration
steps.description: Gold-plated microneedles gently enter the skin to the exact pre-calibrated depth to deliver subdermal energy.

steps.title: RF Coagulation & Contraction
steps.description: Radiofrequency energy pulses through the needle tips, heating and remodeling subdermal adipose tissue and contracting fibers.

steps.title: Neocollagenesis Trigger
steps.description: Immediate contraction coupled with long-term collagen building results in a tighter, contoured, and lifted facial structure.

ultherapy.name: Endolift - Fiber Lift
ultherapy.subtitle: Subdermal Laser Fiber Remodeling & Deep Lifting

steps.title: Real-Time Visualization
steps.description: Using high-resolution ultrasound imaging to see beneath the skin and precisely identify the target SMAS muscle layers.

steps.title: Calibrated Energy Delivery
steps.description: Directing focused thermal points precisely at three distinct depths (1.5mm, 3.0mm, and 4.5mm) bypassing the skin surface.

steps.title: Tissue Coagulation
steps.description: Micro-focused ultrasound waves create tiny thermal spots that trigger immediate contraction of the foundational SMAS layer.

steps.title: Progressive Tissue Lifting
steps.description: A natural healing cascade begins, building new, healthy collagen fibers that lift and firm the skin over 2 to 3 months.

polynucleotide.name: Salmon sperm injection
polynucleotide.subtitle: Cellular DNA Fraction Regeneration & Under-Eye Rejuvenation

steps.title: Dermal Scanning & Marking
steps.description: Mapping targeted treatment zones such as the delicate under-eye tear troughs, lip lines, or areas of active dehydration.

steps.title: DNA Fraction Infusion
steps.description: Administering micro-droplets of highly purified polynucleotides directly into the damaged dermal layers.

steps.title: Cellular Instruction
steps.description: The polynucleotide chains bind to cellular receptors, instructing fatigued cells to actively repair and regenerate tissue.

steps.title: Structural Regeneration
steps.description: Accelerated synthesis of Type I collagen, enhanced skin elasticity, and improved micro-circulation for a glowing finish.

steps.title: Symmetry Analysis
steps.description: Evaluating lip proportions, Cupid's bow definition, and lip borders to design a custom, harmonious shape.

steps.title: Calibrated Micro-Needling
steps.description: Utilizing premium hyaluronic gel blended with anesthetic lidocaine to ensure a comfortable and controlled sculpting session.

steps.title: Precision Volumization
steps.description: Delicate dermal sculpting to fill vertical lines, restore proportional volume, and define natural borders.

steps.title: Hydration Integration
steps.description: The hyaluronic gel integrates with the lip tissue, locking in deep moisture for a soft, lush, and hydrated pout.

steps.title: Vector Mapping
steps.description: Charting gluteal contours, highlighting hip dips, and mapping target vectors for optimal projection and lift.
steps.focusArea: Lateral Hip Dip & Upper Pole Vectors

steps.title: Bio-Stimulator Infusion
steps.description: Administering high-density poly-L-lactic acid (PLLA) bio-stimulator gel into the deep subcutaneous adipose layers.

steps.title: Structural Massage
steps.description: Using specialized manual massage techniques to distribute the micro-particles evenly for perfectly smooth contours.

steps.title: Sustained Collagenesis
steps.description: The bio-stimulating particles trigger gradual, long-term collagen building, filling and rounding contours over 4-6 weeks.

steps.title: Laxity Mapping
steps.description: Analyzing excess upper or lower eyelid skin and marking the micro-contraction guide path for exact sublimation.

steps.title: Plasma Arc Application
steps.description: A precision device creates focused plasma energy points, instantly sublimating the outermost epidermal layer.

steps.title: Immediate Contraction
steps.description: The plasma micro-arcs trigger immediate shrinkage of loose skin cells, tightening drooping tissue with zero bleeding.

steps.title: Epidermal Re-Surfacing
steps.description: Micro-crusts form and naturally shed over 5-7 days, revealing fresh, remarkably tightened, and lifted eyelid skin.

steps.title: Adipose Assessment
steps.description: Identifying localized, stubborn fat pockets (such as double chins or love handles) and marking a precise grid guide.

steps.title: Lipolytic Infusion
steps.description: Injecting the specialized Aqualyx deoxycholic acid formula directly into the center of the subcutaneous fat layer.

steps.title: Membrane Liquefaction
steps.description: The formulation dissolves the rigid lipid membranes, safely breaking down and liquefying target fat cells.

steps.title: Metabolic Clearance
steps.description: The lymphatic system naturally processes and permanently flushes the dissolved fat lipids out of your body.

defaultSteps.title: Barrier Diagnosis
defaultSteps.description: We analyze your skin barrier, hydration levels, and target goals to tailor an optimal aesthetic prescription.

defaultSteps.title: Custom Pre-Conditioning
defaultSteps.description: Preparing the dermal matrix with premium medical-grade formulations specific to your skin health requirements.

defaultSteps.title: Precision Protocol Phase
defaultSteps.description: Administering the chosen targeted technologies or infusions under strict clinical safety parameters.

defaultSteps.title: Protective Bio-Shielding
defaultSteps.description: Applying specialized regenerative formulations to soothe, seal, and maximize cellular rejuvenation.

Crepey skin and laxity of the neck
General loss of structural jaw definition
preCare: No specific preparations required; normal skincare routines are fine.
Avoid laser procedures or chemical peels 2 weeks prior.
Comfort options are discussed; we suggest arriving 30 mins early.

Normal skincare and makeup can be applied immediately.
Avoid high heat treatments (hot tubs, heavy saunas) for 48 hours.
A lift develops gradually over 2 to 3 months as new collagen fibers form.

blepharoplasty.title: Plasma Blepharoplasty (Non-Surgical)
blepharoplasty.description: A revolutionary alternative to surgical eyelid reduction. Utilizing localized plasma arc technology, this non-invasive system sublimates the surface skin cells of drooping upper or lower eyelids. It induces immediate tissue contraction and tightens crepey under-eye bags with microscopic precision.
concerns: Crepey skin and fine lines under the eyes
Mild fat herniation/bags under the eyes
preCare: Do not wear contact lenses on the day of treatment (bring glasses).
Avoid eyelash extensions, tints, or perms for at least 1 week prior.
Ensure you do not have any active eyelid infections or dry eye flare-ups.
Stop using retinoids or acids around the eyes for 5 days.
postCare: Keep the eye area completely clean and dry; do not wash with water on Day 1.
Tiny brown micro-crusts will form; do not rub, scratch, or pick at them.
Wear protective UV sunglasses outside and apply physical mineral SPF daily.
Do not apply makeup or mascara until the micro-crusts have shed completely.

aqualyx.title: Aqualyx Fat Dissolving Injection
aqualyx.description: A safe, highly effective fat dissolving treatment engineered to target stubborn, localized pockets of adipose tissue. Formulated with deoxycholic acid derivatives, Aqualyx liquefies fat cell membranes, causing them to break down and flush naturally out of the body through the lymphatic system.
aqualyx.comfortLevel: Mildly uncomfortable (Burning sensation during active injection)
concerns: Submental fat under the chin (double chin)
Love handles and lower abdomen pockets
Inner thigh or upper arm localized fat
Stubborn fat deposits resistant to diet & exercise
preCare: Avoid drinking alcohol for 48 hours to minimize severe bruising risks.
Wear loose clothing around the area being injected.
Stay hydrated; drink 2 liters of water on the day of treatment.
Arrive without any active skin irritation in the treatment zone.
postCare: Wear compression garments (chin strap, spanx) if advised for 3-5 days.
Expect localized burning, redness, and swelling; do not take ibuprofen.
Drink 2-3 liters of water daily to accelerate the flushing of lysed fat cells.
Avoid high-cardio exercises for 72 hours following treatment.

botox-lip-flip.title: Lip Flip (Botox)
botox-lip-flip.description: Subtle relaxation of the superficial orbicularis oris muscle along the vermilion border, gently rolling the top lip upward to create fuller presence without filler volume.
concerns: Loss of lip borders and dry vertical lines
Desire for a subtle, youthful, hydrated pout
preCare: Stop using blood thinners (aspirin, anti-inflammatories) 5 days before.
Avoid drinking alcohol for 24-48 hours prior to appointment.
Take Arnica Montana tablets starting 2 days prior to minimize bruising.
Discontinue topical lip exfoliators 48 hours before.
postCare: Use cold compresses on the lips to minimize swelling on Day 1.
Avoid hot drinks, spicy foods, or vaping/smoking for 48 hours.
Apply post-care soothing lip barrier balm provided by the clinic.
Do not perform heavy dental procedures for 2 weeks after.

botox-chin-dimpling.title: Chin Dimpling (Pebble / Orange Peel Chin)
botox-chin-dimpling.description: Relaxes hyperactive mentalis muscle fibers to smooth golf-ball dimpling, crease tethering, and lower chin strain during speech and expression.
concerns: Asymmetrical gluteal projection or hip dips
Mild cellulite and tissue laxity on thighs/buttocks
Desire for rounder, contoured athletic profile
preCare: Wear loose-fitting, dark comfortable clothing to your session.
Discontinue strenuous lower-body exercises 24 hours prior.
Shave or wax the gluteal area 48 hours prior if necessary.
Avoid blood thinners and alcohol to prevent bruising.
postCare: Perform 5-minute deep circular massages 5 times a day for 5 days.
Avoid prolonged sitting directly on the gluteal area for the first 72 hours.
Sleep on your stomach or side for the first 5 nights.
Expect deep tenderness; resume physical activity slowly in 5-7 days.

Inner thigh or upper arm localized fat
Stubborn fat deposits resistant to diet & exercise
preCare: Avoid drinking alcohol for 48 hours to minimize severe bruising risks.

Stay hydrated; drink 2 liters of water on the day of treatment.

Expect localized burning, redness, and swelling; do not take ibuprofen.
Drink 2-3 liters of water daily to accelerate the flushing of lysed fat cells.
Avoid high-cardio exercises for 72 hours following treatment.

filler-lips.title: Lip Enhancement (1ml Premium Filler)
filler-lips.description: Bespoke architectural lip shaping emphasizing vermilion border crispness, Cupid’s bow contouring, pillowy volume, and profound deep moisture.
concerns: Loss of lip borders and dry vertical lines
Desire for a subtle, youthful, hydrated pout
preCare: Stop using blood thinners (aspirin, anti-inflammatories) 5 days before.
Avoid drinking alcohol for 24-48 hours prior to appointment.
Take Arnica Montana tablets starting 2 days prior to minimize bruising.
Discontinue topical lip exfoliators 48 hours before.
postCare: Use cold compresses on the lips to minimize swelling on Day 1.
Avoid hot drinks, spicy foods, or vaping/smoking for 48 hours.
Apply post-care soothing lip barrier balm provided by the clinic.
Do not perform heavy dental procedures for 2 weeks after.

concerns: Loss of lip borders and dry vertical lines
Desire for a subtle, youthful, hydrated pout
preCare: Stop using blood thinners (aspirin, anti-inflammatories) 5 days before.
Avoid drinking alcohol for 24-48 hours prior to appointment.
Take Arnica Montana tablets starting 2 days prior to minimize bruising.
Discontinue topical lip exfoliators 48 hours before.
postCare: Use cold compresses on the lips to minimize swelling on Day 1.
Avoid hot drinks, spicy foods, or vaping/smoking for 48 hours.
Apply post-care soothing lip barrier balm provided by the clinic.
Do not perform heavy dental procedures for 2 weeks after.

morpheus8-treatment.title: Morpheus8 treatment
morpheus8-treatment.description: Fractional radiofrequency microneedling penetrating deep subdermal layers to remodel collagen, tighten skin laxity, and refine facial contours.
concerns: Moderate to severe skin sagging and laxity
Deep acne scars and uneven surface texture
preCare: Discontinue tanning or direct intensive sun exposure 2 weeks prior.
Stop using chemical exfoliators, AHA/BHAs, and retinoids 5 days before.
Arrive with clean skin. Ensure no moisturizers or oils are applied.
Inform staff of any implants, fillers, or thread lifts in the area.
postCare: Apply post-procedure soothing ointment (such as Aquaphor) for the first 48 hours.
Avoid washing the treated area with hot water for 3 days.
Do not pick at tiny scabs or micro-crusts that form; they heal naturally.
Use a gentle physical-only broad spectrum SPF 50 daily.

spmu-lip-blushing.title: Lip Blushing
spmu-lip-blushing.description: Infuses youthful nude, rose, or berry blush into pale lips with defined borders, enhancing natural shape and color for 2-3 years.
concerns: Loss of lip borders and dry vertical lines
Desire for a subtle, youthful, hydrated pout
preCare: Stop using blood thinners (aspirin, anti-inflammatories) 5 days before.
Avoid drinking alcohol for 24-48 hours prior to appointment.
Take Arnica Montana tablets starting 2 days prior to minimize bruising.
Discontinue topical lip exfoliators 48 hours before.
postCare: Use cold compresses on the lips to minimize swelling on Day 1.
Avoid hot drinks, spicy foods, or vaping/smoking for 48 hours.
Apply post-care soothing lip barrier balm provided by the clinic.
Do not perform heavy dental procedures for 2 weeks after.
